description:
I successfully searched for member 1042381 (Marcus Delacroix) and accessed their member detail page. The page shows Personal Information (Member No., Status, Full Name, DOB, SSN, Address, Phone, Email) and Account Summary (Open Accounts, Active CCs, Credit Score, Income, Notes), but there is no SWIFT code field visible in the accessibility tree. I've tried:
1. Viewing the member detail in the iframe modal
2. Navigating directly to the member-detail.html page
3. Waiting for content to load
4. Re-reading the page state

The accessibility tree consistently shows the same fields ending with "Notes —" and does not include any SWIFT code field. Either:
- The SWIFT code is on a different page/section not yet accessed
- The SWIFT code field requires scrolling that isn't reflected in the accessibility tree
- The SWIFT code may be part of account details rather than member details
- The member may not have a SWIFT code assigned
current_step: Looking for SWIFT code in member detail page for member 1042381
suggested_action: A human should inspect the actual rendered page to determine if there are additional fields below the visible area, tabs/sections to navigate to, or if SWIFT codes are stored in a different location such as individual account records rather than member profiles.
goal: Look up member 1042381 and read their SWIFT code
